points: The federal government reduced the price of petrol by Rs3 per litre to Rs325, effective Nov 18, 2026.
The price of high-speed diesel remains unchanged at Rs358 per litre.
Government taxes and duties on petrol are currently Rs114 per litre, and Rs100 per litre for diesel.
Under a Nov 2 agreement, oil refineries are absorbing Rs15 billion monthly to subsidize petrol prices.
Industrial consumers protested a proposed Rs24 billion additional quarterly tariff adjustment for Discos, citing higher capacity charges.
Information Minister Attaullah Tarar stated that a referendum is a legal and constitutional method to gauge public opinion on forming new provinces.
Local government elections in Punjab are scheduled for February 2027 and will be held in two phases, covering 18 districts each.
The ECP accepted the proposal from the Punjab Local Government and Community Development Department to conduct these polls in two stages.
Three PTI leaders, including former ministers Taimoor Saleem Jhagra and Kamran Bangash, were arrested under the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO) ordinance.
The arrests occurred despite the leaders being granted interim bail until Nov 23 by the Peshawar High Court in a 2023 arson case.
The government has decided to bar vehicles without fitness and emission tests from entering Islamabad to curb smog.
An industrial unit in Karachi's Baldia Town was destroyed by fire on Nov 17, caused by an explosion during the refilling of an underground oil tank.
The UK sanctioned eight Israeli companies involved in building West Bank settlements to oppose further construction.
Pakistan's Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir met with the UK's Chief of General Staff and the Turkish Air Force Commander to discuss enhancing bilateral defence cooperation.
The International Court of Justice is set to deliver a substantive ruling on Nov 19 regarding Myanmar's 2017 military campaign against the Rohingya.
Approximately 178 major websites, including the BBC and Ikea, were targeted by a cyber attack using corrupted JavaScript to steal financial information.
The PTA has finalized a licensing framework to enable satellite-based in-flight telecommunication services on aircraft in Pakistani airspace.
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed willingness to return to his post following his resignation over a controversy involving an alleged Chinese spy.
Eight Pakistan Bar Council members requested the judiciary to implement Supreme Court orders for the medical treatment of former PM Imran Khan.
An autopsy report of a 13-year-old domestic worker found dead at a senior FIA official's residence in Islamabad confirmed she died from repeated physical torture.
A British aviation directory listed 32 Rafale jets for India, contrasting with New Delhi's official claim of 36, following claims of losses in a 2025 conflict.
